factualReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Technology and Inventions reviewer
factualReview.notes: Independently read all250 claims against actual cached source passages, including targeted full extracts when relevance selection missed the claim. Read actual W3C images guidance, Bethesda Doom name history, NASA Stardust and gravity-assist pages, Arup Eastgate design page, BASF/Lufthansa AeroSHARK primary pages, NIST katal/digital-signature/binary-prefix material, official Debian naming history and official Japanese YKK initials history. Resolved percent-encoded source snapshot gaps for Prince Rupert/Fitts/Hick/Amdahl/C++/De Morgan. Rechecked new citations and final repairs.

editorialReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Technology and Inventions reviewer
editorialReview.notes: Independently read all250 records,50 category titles and all final old/new collision pairs against the full8374-record baseline including Finals. Replaced repeated or reverse-identical queried facts with genuinely different questions. Removed answer-giving alias stems, checked five distinct primary subjects per category, preserved allocation/rounds and matched title scope to all five questions. Final bank audit has zero structural issues and zero answer-leak candidates.

translationReview.reviewer: Codex Root, independent Technology and Inventions reviewer
translationReview.notes: Read all English/Estonian clues, responses, explanations, variants and actual diagnostics. Repaired case/plural endings, translated technical terms, explicit English word-origin context and paired accepted aliases. Corrected indentation from taandrida to taandus, dead reckoning and eventual consistency meaning, pump-storage wording and number spacing. Final translation diagnostics have zero blocking errors; approved field-specific exceptions cover valid names, inflections and translated descriptive titles.

Replaced YouTube first-video identification with founders’ previous PayPal employer; Hubble repair with Edwin Hubble’s profession; heat-pump efficiency with district heating.

Replaced repeated lumen and digital-signature definitions with katal and non-repudiation; repeated dome identification with skylight; haptic feedback definition with Greek word origin.
Removed walkie-talkie and PPI accepted-alias leakage; changed magnetron clue to Randall/Boot Birmingham1940 attribution rather than repeated appliance mapping.

Narrowed Shinkansen/kingfisher to sourced nose-shape inspiration and gecko question to reusable self-cleaning adhesive application; avoided unsupported performance claims and disputed exclusive adhesion mechanism.
